programme.title: Potluck Teacher
programme.desc: A sports card clerk becomes an unlikely savior when two clueless teens invite him to their high school. Behind Harrison Jones' ordinary facade lies an extraordinary past that ignites a classroom revolution. Watch as hardened rebels are transformed when Jones cracks their defensive shells and exposes their hidden vulnerabilities. This emotional rollercoaster follows broken teenagers as they find strength through unexpected connections, guided by Jones's mysterious wisdom toward healing.

programme.title: Matters of the Heart
programme.desc: Matters of the Heart follows three couples at different life stages: new lovers discovering each other online, a 13-year marriage in crisis, and longtime partners facing illness-a beautiful tapestry of love, loss, and hope.

programme.title: Was Once A Hero
programme.desc: In a heart-pounding tale of survival, Ginny and her little brother Little Bit are on the run after their father is brutally murdered by the unhinged outlaw Chance and his gang. As they navigate an unforgiving desert, Ginny wrestles with the haunting memories of her father's death and the guilt of taking a life to protect herself. Just when hope seems lost, they encounter Major Malcolm Hunter, a once-great war hero, now battling memory loss and fading into obscurity.

programme.title: Wisher Maddox
programme.desc: Eight-year-old orphan Maddox discovers a miraculous gift-he can make wishes come true for everyone except himself. Raised within institutional walls, his deepest wish is to find a loving family. Hope fills his heart after receiving what he believes is a divine sign. Yet while his wishes transform others' lives, his prayer for adoption remains unanswered.

programme.title: Candlelight My Way
programme.desc: Following George and Cathy on the brink of divorce. George, a devout man of faith, returns from frequent work trips to find Cathy increasingly drawn to friends who challenge their family values. While she yearns for missed youthful experiences, he firmly holds his religious convictions as their foundation. Their child silently witnesses their growing divide. As ultimatums emerge and compromise seems impossible, both must confront difficult questions: What truly matters in marriage?

programme.desc: A filmmaker pitches four different stories to a producer for a film. Each story reflects a unique aspect of the filmmaker's life, revealing personal connections and experiences. programme.title: Satchi Perumal

On relocating to Mumbai, his luck shines and he becomes a superstar in no time. However, success comes at a high price for Ashfaque and he is forced to compromise the very principles he grew up with. Ashfaque's dishonesty alienates him from his family and he begins to feel lonely in the world of superstardom.

programme.desc: Kathir (Vijay Sethupathi), a righteous, aspiring music composer, falls in love with Meera (Gayathrie), an unassuming music teacher. programme.title: Rail

programme.title: Fun2Ssh
programme.desc: A notorious thief Chindi (Gulshan Grover) carries out the theft of Emperor Babushah's (also Gulshan Grover) priceless crown. Vikram (Iqbal Khan), Ajay (Anuj Sawhney) and John D'Souza (Paresh Rawal) become prime suspects and are on the run. While being chased by security guards, the trio crash into a wall, and are transported back to the 10th century, straight into the palace of Emperor Babushah himself.

programme.title: Love Love Love
programme.desc: Amit (Aamir Khan), the kind-hearted son of a taxi driver and Reema (Juhi Chawla), the daughter of a rich businessman are college-mates who fall head over heels in love with each other. But Reema has another unruly suitor Vicky (Gulshan Grover) who would stop at nothing to claim her. Reema's father too wants her to marry Vicky, the son of a dangerous gangster he is indebted to. With her father's blessings in place, Vicky has nothing to fear.

programme.title: Ishqiya
programme.desc: Ishqiya is a story about love arising in characters, portrayed uniquely according to their own personal traits. The situations in the plot lead the characters to experience the emotion creeping into their lives in the most unexpected manner

programme.title: LOHA
programme.desc: When an officer is crippled after a failed attempt to arrest a criminal, he decides to hire two crooks for the job.

programme.title: Waqt Hamara Hai
programme.desc: After a wobbly start, two good-for-nothing collegiates Vikas (Akshay Kumar) and Sunil (Sunil Shetty) become best friends and fall in love with two fellow college girls. All is well, until a terrorist group led by Colonel Chikara (Rami Reddy) hides a bag of 'Crypton', a nuclear missile material, in Vikas's car while fleeing from the police. Unable to trace it later, the terrorists kidnap Vikas and his girlfriend, and bully Sunil into bringing the bag to them.

programme.title: Missing On A Weekend
programme.desc: Police inspector Ali Ansari (Pavan Malhotra) from CBI has been transferred to Goa to take charge of the ugly undercover crime space. Ansari has now got a new case in the mid of all the chaos where one guy, Laksh (Karan Hariharan) has been found unconscious on beach. He is brutally hurt his head and lost substantial part of his memory.

programme.title: Half Nelson
programme.desc: Dan Dunne (Ryan Gosling) is a history teacher at a Brooklyn school. Though well-liked by his students and colleagues, he secretly spends his evenings hopping bars and getting high. A female student named Drey (Shareeka Epps) catches him in a drug-induced haze after a basketball game, and the two strike up an unlikely friendship. As Dan struggles with his addiction, he tries to act as a mentor to the girl, whose brother is serving time for dealing drugs.

programme.title: My Dinner With Andre
programme.desc: Old friends Wallace (Wallace Shawn) and Andre (Andre Gregory) haven't seen each another in five years and agree to meet for dinner. Andre, a once well-known theater director, dropped out of the New York scene to travel the world, while Wallace stuck around, finding only mixed success as a playwright. As they sit down to eat, Andre launches into a series of fantastic stories from his time away, and Wallace can't help but notice how different their worldviews have become.

programme.title: Glengarry Glen Ross
programme.desc: When an office full of New York City real estate salesmen is given the news that all but the top two will be fired at the end of the week, the atmosphere begins to heat up. Shelley Levene (Jack Lemmon), who has a sick daughter, does everything in his power to get better leads from his boss, John Williamson (Kevin Spacey), but to no avail. When his coworker Dave Moss (Ed Harris) comes up with a plan to steal the leads, things get complicated for the tough-talking salesmen.

programme.title: Whale Rider
programme.desc: Only males are allowed to ascend to chiefdom in a Maori tribe in New Zealand. This ancient custom is upset when the child selected to be the next chief dies at birth. However his twin sister, Pai (Keisha Castle-Hughes), survives. At age 12, she enlists the help of her grandmother (Vicky Haughton) and the training of her uncle (Grant Roa) to claim her birthright. But to break with convention, she'll have to do the impossible: win over her ultra-traditional grandfather (Rawiri Paratene).

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: A man steps out of a fountain in a park in Ho Chi Minh City with no memory of who he is. He wanders the city trying to piece together his past while being pursued by mysterious figures.

programme.title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead

He ropes his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke), into a scheme to commit the perfect crime: to rob their parents' (Albert Finney, Rosemary Harris) jewelry store. The scheme goes horribly awry, and the family patriarch takes justice into his own hands, unaware that the criminals he is hunting are his own sons.

programme.title: The Loft

Realizing that her killer must be one of their group, the men are gripped by paranoia as each one suspects another. Friendships are tested, loyalties are questioned, and marriages crumble while fear and suspicion run rampant.

programme.title: Nightcrawler

When he catches the eye of a shopworn news director (Rene Russo) who welcomes the chance to raise her station's ratings, Louis goes to increasingly greater lengths to catch the "money shot."

programme.title: Fear Factor USA

programme.title: Fear Factor USA

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Valparaiso, Indiana to investigate the Inn at Aberdeen. The house dates back to the 1850's and was purchased by the Ritter family, who were thought to be involved in the Underground Railroad. The house changed ownership over the years until the client, John, purchased it in 1995. Since then reports of paranormal activity have been accumulating.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays close to home by investigating the Westerly Library, in Westerly, Rhode Island. In 1892 Steven and Harriett Wilcox agreed to fund an in memoriam library in horror of Civil War soldiers. The library was completed in 1894, but unfortunately Mr. Wilcox did not live long enough to see it completed. The library has grown to over 50,000 square feet and has been designated as Rhode Island's first literary landmark.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.
programme.sub-title: Give Me Liberty or Give Me Corpses

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Cornwall Bridge, Connecticut to investigate the Vogel Residence. Their client, Robin Vogel, is afraid that the Curse Of Dudleytown has spread to her home and has asked TAPS to help. Dudleytown was an abandoned settlement that dates back to the 1740's. Many people believe the settlement was cursed due to the fact that many inhabitants died a violent death or went insane. The Vogel Residence was originally built in 1780 with an addition put on in 1830.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Wilmington, Delaware to investigate Rockwood Museum. They are joined by two of their paranormal friends: actors Rachel Nichols, and Jonathan Sadowski. The original owner of the mansion was Joseph Shipley. He was born into a wealthy family in Wilmington, but made his own money as a merchant banker in Liverpool, England. He built Rockwood Mansion in 1854 to resemble his Liverpool home, Wyncote.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: We are introduced to Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson, co-founders and lead investigators for The Atlantic Paranormal Society (TAPS). Their Technical Manager, Brian Harnois, tells them of an interesting case. The home they are to investigate is in Altoona, PA which is several hours away, but because of the dramatic nature of the case they decide to make the long drive. They investigate reports of poltergeist activity in a home with a very young girl who seems to see the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn in New London, Conn., which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride who fell down a flight of stairs on her wedding day in 1930. Drops in temperature are recorded, and Steve feels someone touch him on his back when no one else is nearby. They then travel to Ashland, Mass. to a pub called Stone's Public House, formerly The Railroad House. Here, a little girl died after being hit by a train.
programme.sub-title: Lighthouse Inn and John Stone Tarvern / The Lighthouse Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: At the request of the US Coast Guard, TAPS goes to Long Island Sound to investigate the Race Rock Lighthouse. The lighthouse is now automated, but the Coast Guard officers who come to do maintenance and inspection have reported strange occurrences and are nervous about going to the site. The commanding officers hope to disprove the rumors. The team's cameras pick up strange orb activity and a fog which the investigators do not remember from the time of the video.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates Eastern State Penitentiary, an abandoned prison with a long, colorful history and a reputation for paranormal activity. While there, they capture a strange, shadowy shape on film. After reviewing the film, Jason decides that the team should return. More orbs are caught on film, but no repeat of the shadowy figure. Efforts to duplicate the footage prove unsuccessful, but Jason and Grant see how it could have been done.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church. They claim to have seen apparitions and to have heard strange noises. Also, one of the doors in the house opens by itself. The investigation turns up only orbs caused by dust. Jason determines that the sounds and orbs are caused by the settling of the wood beams when the church bell rings. The team is able to duplicate the opening door, giving a mundane explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Reports of disturbances in a college student group house are easily explained as acoustics and encounters with neighbors who were drunk at the time. At the Topton House Pub, witnesses have reported that the ghost of a little girl sometimes trips people on the steps and has moved glasses of soda on one table. The daughter of the owner has also smelled roses while in the cellar and heard murmurring voices.
programme.sub-title: Fortuna Apartment, Topton House, & Frank's Interview / Fortuna & Topton

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Mike Sinclair, the founder of O.R.I.O.N. Paranormal and a TAPS family member, has called in TAPS to co-investigate the New Boston Inn, in the Berkshires. After examining his findings, the TAPS team is able to disprove or cast doubt upon, everything he found. However, the experience their own incident when a pen seems to have moved with no one else nearby. Next they travel to Pittsburgh to investigate the home of Gloria and Genny.
programme.sub-title: New Boston Inn & Gloria's House / New Boston Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates two cases. First they go to Albany, NY to the home of Linda Johnson. Linda claims to be psychically sensitive, and to have been accosted by a negative or ""demonic"" entity. No conclusive evidence is found, but Jason suggests that Keith Johnson contact her separately to try to help further. Next, they meet Adam Zubrowski, who seems to be experiencing strange events. The house was built by his grandparents, and his grandfather died there.
programme.sub-title: Johnson House & Zubrowski House / The Negative Entity

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS helps a family whose young children claim to be tormented by ghosts. They find bones under the floorboards. After further analysis, the bones are not human but animal and the footage shows that the little boy, not ghosts, is waking up his sister in the middle of the night. Then TAPS helps a young woman who is experiencing lots of paranormal activity in her home. Jason is attacked and TAPS concludes that the entity is focused on the young woman.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to New Orleans for a case with a jealous female spirit who won't leave the male homeowner alone. They find evidence that supports the victim's claims when they viewfootage of a door that opens and shuts on its own. While in town, they go to Brennan's restaurant for a meal and some ghost hunting. But their EVPs are tainted by noises that are coming from a private party.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian can't go on this road trip. A training mission in North Carolina goes awry when team members get food poisoning. A local ghost hunting group asks TAPS for help with a haunted battleship. Jason and Grant are chased through the bowels of the ship. There are a lot of personal experiences but the team fails to capture anything on tape. The results are inconclusive.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian leaves TAPS. Andy persuades Jason and Grant to investigate a haunted lighthouse. Steve and Andy experience a cold spot but nothing else happens. Jason and Grant tell Andy he should be more diligent with his case studies. TAPS travel to New York for a haunted museum. Andy gets in a tiff with the other members. The team doesn't capture any evidence of a haunting.
programme.sub-title: New London Lighthouse & Merchant's House Museum

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Steve gets promoted to Tech Manager. TAPS takes on a case that has a personal connection for Kristyn, one of their members. A little boy claims he is being attacked by an entity while his mother suffers dizzy spells whenever she's in the basement. The team discovers high EMF readings and concludes this could be the cause of the dizzy spells since there carbon monoxide leaks weren't detected.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS searches for paranormal evidence at a lavish historical estate in Rhode Island. They debunk the cold spots in the basement when they find a blocked heating system. They do not find any evidence of a haunting. A young and inexperienced paranormal group in New Jersey contacts TAPS for help because they are out of their league. The victim is so frightened she won't allow herself to be seen on camera. TAPS captures recorded sounds of footsteps in her home just as she had reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS returns to Philadelphia's Eastern State Penitentiary to track down an apparition; the team investigates a haunted vacation home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to California to investigate two locations at the top of their Most Haunted list. The first stop is the Winchester Mystery House in San Jose where Dave and Donna's inexperience in the tech department starts to annoy Steve. Jason and Grant debunk cold spots. They don't capture any evidence of paranormal activity. At the Queen Mary in Long Beach, the team seems overwhelmed by the size of the ship. Jason, Grant and Steve are able to debunk some of the ghostly activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to Ohio to investigate Mansfield State Penitentiary, the location of The Shawshank Redemption film. Dave and Dustin chase a dark shadow down one of the cell blocks. Jason and Grant hear an unseen visitor running on the walkway above them. The team fails to collect any ghostly evidence. They head to Massachusetts and investigate the former home of the infamous Lizzie Borden who was accused of viciously murdering her father and step-mother with an axe.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Kentucky to investigate one of the most haunted places in the country, Waverly Hills Sanatorium. During the decades the facility served as a tuberculosis hospital, where an estimated 63,000 people died within its walls. Over two nights of extensive investigation, the members of TAPS have a variety of inexplicable encounters and eerie personal experiences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to searches Holliston, Massachusetts to help a family that has a spirit haunting their home. Loud footsteps are frequently heard up and down the staircase, an apparition has appeared in the master bedroom, and a voice has been heard yelling "mommy". Their young daughter is so terrified that she refuses to step foot in the basement and does not feel comfortable anywhere in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Jason's hometown of Canandaigua, in upstate New York, to investigate two reported hauntings. A sinister force seems to be at work in the Leonard household. The homeowners have encountered various unsettling noises and events, including witnessing a full bodied apparition in their infant son's bedroom. Concern turned to panic when the homeowners discovered scratches on the back of their infant son's neck. TAPS arrives to uncover what is plaguing the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS answers an urgent call from a homeowner in Clinton, Massachusetts, who is being plagued by a disturbing spirit. Aided by Mike Dion, a member of the New England Paranormal Group, TAPS explores the home and immediately feels an uncomfortable presence throughout. Events escalate until Grant is knocked to his knees. Donna is visibly horrified by Grant's experience, but pushes on with the investigation to find out what other surprises the night may hold.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Florida to investigate the paranormal activities at the historical St. Augustine Lighthouse. Armed with some new equipment, the TAPS team investigates the numerous accounts of inexplicable voices, noises and apparitions that have been reported for decades. Steve must confront his fear of heights in order to investigate the towering lighthouse, which is one of the tallest in the country. Immediately after setting up, TAPS begins to experience all sorts of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Roselle Park, New Jersey to investigate an Italian restaurant that is being plagued by a deceased former owner. Current employees believe such incidents as stools being knockedover can be attributed to a former owner, Eda, who died decades earlier in the building. The TAPS team sets out to prove whether or not Eda still lingers on the premises.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Guthrie, Oklahoma to investigate The Stone Lion Inn, a bed and breakfast experiencing paranormal phenomenon. A man dressed in Victorian attire has repeatedly been witnessed by visitors and employees of the former funeral parlor. During the investigation, a number of disturbing audio recordings are captured, including the chilling voice of a child asking "can you find me?" At one point, during the still of the night, Grant even hears his own name being whispered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Stanley Hotel, the location that inspired Stephen King's classic novel "The Shining", is the setting for this TAPS investigation. The team travels to Estes Park, Colorado to explore The Stanley Hotel and discover what truth lies behind the fiction of the famous thriller. During the tour, TAPS is presented with stories of apparition sightings, noises of a large party coming from an empty ballroom, and even a horrifying case of apparent possession.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel. Built in 1902, the establishment is brimming with frequent sightings of numerous apparitions. These include a little boy named Billy, who is believed to have drowned in a nearby river. Some of the most startling encounters have taken place in the "Julia Lowell Room" where, long ago, a woman of the same name committed suicide.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Vermont, a terrified family calls upon TAPS for assistance with startling paranormal events that are taking place in their home. Since they began renovating, the Johnsons have repeatedly seen so-called "shadow people" moving through their house. One night while sleeping, Sean Johnson, the patriarch of the home, was attacked by forces that cannot be seen.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this special episode, TAPS presents investigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the unprecedented live broadcast from The Stanley Hotel in Estes Park, Colorado. Nearly 30 years ago, Stephen King's strange encounters during his stay at the establishment prompted him to write the classic horror novel "The Shining". During their intense investigation, TAPS experiences an incredible amount of paranormal activity in the rooms, halls and in the underbelly of the notorious hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For their first overseas investigation, TAPS travels to Ireland to explore the legendary Leap Castle. Hundreds of years old, the historic grounds are said to be the home to numerous malevolent spirits, but none more frightening than a mysterious entity known as the "Elemental". Witnesses claim that the Elemental is an evil energy created from the castle's bloody past, where it served as a place of torture and brutal murder.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruins in Ireland. These ancient ruins of a grand yet cursed estate are reportedly home to "fairies", troll-like spirits that live underground and wreak havoc on those who trespass. During an intense investigation, the team sets out to learn the truth behind the legends. What was already an unusual investigation turns to panic as TAPS realize they are being hunted by something from the beyond.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A local homeowner in need of emergency assistance visits the TAPS office after a series of bizarre incidents threaten the tranquility of her home. Lynn Tedeschi has the sense that something mysterious, and possibly dangerous, is present in her home. Her children are terrified by toys which inexplicably turn on and off. Strange sounds move through the home as if echoing from the distant past. TAPS spends the night to determine if a haunted house is lurking in their own backyard.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to the aid of a family in Chesapeake, Virginia terrified by the arrival of paranormal activity in their home. Ever since the Keffers began remodeling, they have been plagued by bizarre events. These include the unexplained movement of antique dolls and the sighting of apparitions dressed in period clothing. The Keffers' situation is compounded because they are members of the Mennonite religious community.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A battle scarred warship sets the stage for one of TAPS' largest investigations to date. Docked in Corpus Christi, Texas, the U.S.S. Lexington served in many missions during World War II. Over 300 people lost their lives while serving on the ship, and many witnesses claim these lost souls remain onboard. Countless visitors to the Lexington have seen apparitions dressed in military uniform.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS is in the Pacific Northwest to investigate former insane asylum, the Northern State Hospital. Jason and Grant meet the skeptical caretaker, who wishes to dispel the stories of ghostly activity, but when the team is confronted with strange sounds and shocking evidence, they are left to determine whether or not there might be a little truth to the local tales. Then TAPS heads to Seattle's Underground Tunnels, a subterranean labyrinth below the city streets.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS investigates the historic Presidio in San Francisco. Both employees and members of the military have reported ghostly encounters at this former military fortress. Strange tapping noises, phantom footsteps and sightings of a ghostly female apparition in Spanish attire are just a few of the chilling stories. The TAPS team is left to wonder if there are former soldiers still walking the halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode TAPS is called in to help out a family with an extremely sensitive case. When Krista Gibbons lost her sister she quickly took in her young niece, but soon after the family began hearing the sounds of footsteps in the hall and even witnessed the sight of a black limbless mass wandering throughout the house. The family wondered if their loved one had returned or if this ominous figure was something more sinister.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to the infamous town of Salem, MA for a pair of baffling cases to uncover what vengeful spirits might still roam this site of centuries-old witch trials and executions. The Lyceum Restaurant was formerly the home of Bridget Bishop, the first woman in Salem executed for suspected witchcraft. Witnesses report frequently seeing the apparition of a woman dressed in period clothing.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. They will talk about their favorite investigations and delve into some hot button issues - like Steve's biggest fears. Then the team takes time to answer important questions from viewers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: An urgent call from Dave Tango's father sets the scene for the next case. William Tango, an ex-cop and amateur ghost hunter, was baffled by unexplainable events he experienced on a recent trip to the Burlington County Prison in Mt. Holly, New Jersey. The TAPS team soon discovers William is not alone. Once the site of numerous executions, the prison maintains an unmistakable feeling of dread.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the past nine years unexplainable sounds at the Clapp Library have put Jacques, the night custodian, on edge. The unmistakable sound of books sliding off of shelves and dark shadows moving through the stacks are just some of the eerie events plaguing the library. Desperate to prove to other employees that he's not going crazy, Jacque calls in TAPS to find some answers. During the investigation Jason and Grant hear a strange sound coming from the balcony area.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week the TAPS team heads to the historic Confederate campgrounds of the Cashtown Inn. This old hotel was once the crossroad for Confederate troops on their way to the battle of Gettysburg. The basement of the hotel was later used as a makeshift triage unit, where injured soldiers were often subject to barbaric and crude amputations. Today, hotel guests report countless bizarre experiences, from unexplained sounds in the middle of the night to apparitions roaming the hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, when overwhelming reports of paranormal activity plague the Wright - Patterson Air Force Base, TAPS gets enlisted to help the military. For the past ten years, the air force base has been host to strange experiences. Recent renovations at the base have resulted in escalating activity. At the Arnold House, personnel have reported hearing children's voices and footsteps walking up the stairs. And, in Building 70, ghostly apparitions have put everyone on edge.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS heads to the Mt. Washington Hotel in New Hampshire to be the first paranormal group to investigate this legendary resort. The expansive property sits on top of a massive limestone deposit, known to be a catalyst for paranormal activity. The caretakers here have experienced everything from doors that open and close by themselves to full body apparitions.

programme.title: I Had a Bloody Good Time at House Harker
programme.desc: It's been generations since the Harkers' great-great grandfather killed Count Dracula. Now the Harker brothers and their best friend Ned are a town joke - until a real vampire turns up.

programme.title: Halloween Night
programme.desc: Based on actual events, a man escapes an insane asylum on October 31st to return to his childhood home in hopes of discovering why his mother was murdered. In order to learn the sick and perverse truth, he must kill everyone in his way, including the family who now lives in the house as well as the guests of the Halloween party.

programme.title: Better Criminal
programme.desc: A police officer is forced to work for two warring crime syndicates while under an internal investigation.

programme.title: Rififi in the City
programme.desc: Following his international breakthrough with THE AWFUL DR. ORLOFF, director Jess Franco delivered a startling crime thriller that pistol-whipped European notions of film noir. Jean Servais of RIFIFI fame stars in RIFIFI IN THE CITY, a nihilistic trip through a pulp underworld of thugs, snitches, nightclub dames and black-gloved giallo-style murders.

programme.title: Romeo Section 1: A String of Pearls

Set in Vancouver, the show follows seasoned spymaster Professor Wolfgang McGee, an academic who secretly manages a roster of espionage assets and informants. These assets, referred to as Romeo or Juliet spies, use their powers of seduction to extract secrets from state intelligence targets.

programme.title: Wraith
programme.desc: After living in an old mansion for almost 10 years a family suddenly discovers a ghost-like presence trying to communicate with them.

programme.title: The Beatles: Love Me Do

programme.title: Highlander: The Raven
programme.desc: Amanda and Nick are accused of stealing a $20 million painting and meet up with another Immortal while trying to clear their names.

programme.title: Murderers and Their Mothers
programme.desc: The case of Jed Allen, a young man who on the surface had a happy, stable life. Yet in May 2015 he would kill his mother, step-father and six year old half-sister in a brutal knife attack. MacIntyre and criminologist Dr Elizabeth Yardley explore Jed's dysfunctional childhood years with his mother to discover the trigger that led him to commit family annihilation.

programme.title: The Knight Of Shadows
programme.desc: Pu Songling, a legendary demon hunter, is asked to investigate the mysterious disappearances of young girls from a small village. When he discovers evil forces are kidnapping the girls to feast on their souls, he sets out to save humanity from the inhuman invasion journeying through hidden worlds and colorful dimensions in this fantastical martial arts action-comedy.

programme.title: Maverick: Manhunt Brazil
programme.desc: Mysterious mercenary Jack Maverick (Emiliano Ruschel) arrives in the small town of Passo Fundo, Brazil, after accepting a lucrative contract to investigate a series of suicides.

programme.title: They Saved Hitler's Brain
programme.desc: Nazi madmen preserve Hitler's brain on a small tropical island until the time is right to resurrect him and, along with him, the Third Reich.

programme.title: Eloise
programme.desc: Four friends break into an insane asylum in search of a certificate which will grant one of them a large inheritance.

programme.title: I Had a Bloody Good Time at House Harker
programme.desc: It's been generations since the Harkers' great-great grandfather killed Count Dracula. Now the Harker brothers and their best friend Ned are a town joke - until a real vampire turns up.

programme.title: Yoga Hosers
programme.desc: Two teenage yoga enthusiasts must do battle with an evil presence that is threatening to rise from its underground lair and endanger their major party plans.

programme.title: Haus of Horror
programme.desc: Horror is everywhere you look nowadays; have you wondered how that happened? Haus of Horror is here to explore the influence of horror far and wide. From fashion, food, lifestyle to fake blood, Vanessa will cover it all.

programme.title: Peace Breaker
programme.desc: A corrupt cop makes one wrong decision after another to cover up his misdeads. A remake of Kim Seung-hun's South Korean thriller 'A Hard Day.'

programme.title: Darknet EP 5
programme.desc: A woman is emailed a series of videos showing people being murdered.

programme.title: Blindsided
programme.desc: Sloan Carter is a young girl who has recently been blinded. Her father leaves for the weekend and her two best friends, returning home from University, keep her company. A protege of her father's, passing through town, also spends the night. The peaceful weekend is interrupted by a shadowy threat and the safe country getaway turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: Darknet EP 2
programme.desc: A young cop questions a beautiful woman about a murder in her building.

programme.title: Darknet EP 3
programme.desc: A phone installer shows up at an apartment, setting off a shocking chain of events.

programme.title: Alien Paranormal: Bigfoot, UFOs and Men in Black
programme.desc: Are Bigfoot creatures traveling to earth in UFO's, and being covered-up by Men in Black? Experience terrifying, real events as documented by top authorities, including: Aliens attacking a house; Alien Abductions to create a hybrid race; vortexes and more!

programme.title: Call Me King
programme.desc: In the international world of gun running... loyalty, honor and discretion are valuable commodities, but nothing is more priceless than the bond of family. Power begets enemies and a loved ones betrayal cuts like a knife. Sides will be chosen, wars will be fought. In the end, there can only be one King.

programme.title: Alien From Area 51
programme.desc: Footage of a dead alien from a crashed UFO in Roswell, NM and moved to Area 51 shocked the world. The time is coming for alien intervention on Earth whether we are ready or not.

programme.title: Cape Wrath S1 EP 6

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: 2-Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: When a college educational ship is sunk by a mutated two-headed shark, the survivors escape to a deserted atoll. But when it starts flooding, the coeds are no longer safe from the double jaws of the monster.

programme.title: Comic Book Heroes
programme.desc: After the books finally arrive at Comic-Con, Wolfgang, Skye and their team of talented creators set out to conquer the U.S., but will the stress of running a company between Perth and Tokyo get in the way of their friendship.

programme.title: Flatwoods
programme.desc: A documentary filmmaker uncovers an alien conspiracy in Flatwoods, West Virginia.

programme.title: Ghoul
programme.desc: Three American filmmakers become the targets of the evil spirit of the most violent cannibal in recorded history.

programme.title: Big Ass Spider!

programme.title: Cinco de Chocolate y Uno de Fresa
programme.desc: Una novicia come unos hongos especiales y cambia de personalidad actuando como una alocada joven sicodélica.

programme.title: Alguien nos quiere matar
programme.desc: Carlota es enviada a México para vengar la muerte de su padre y se hace secretaria de Juan, el presunto asesino. Unos extranjeros se únen en un pacto para asesinarlo, pero son tan torpes que terminan matándose entre ellos.

programme.title: Don Juan 67
programme.desc: Una jovencita le tiende una trampa a un hombre mujeriego del que está enamorada para así llamar su atención.

programme.title: Allá en el Rancho Grande
programme.desc: El capataz y el patrón de una hacienda se enamoran de una bella muchacha, pero ella sólo ama al capataz.

programme.title: Cartas Marcadas
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes rancheros reciben una herencia de la madrina de ambos y sólo les será entregada si se casan entre sí.

programme.title: Educando a papá
programme.desc: Un parrandero descubre que su hijo es un médico y hace todo para conseguir su perdón por haber abandonado a su madre.

programme.title: Duro pero seguro
programme.desc: La taquera callejera Nicolasa alcanza una gran popularidad y pone en peligro al restaurante de unos estudios de cine. Cuando se descubre que trae fortuna a su clientela, todos empiezan a considerarla una especie de talismán al que no deben perder la oportunidad de acudir.

programme.title: El Miedo no Anda en Burro
programme.desc: Una anciana es envenenada por sus ambiciosos parientes, pero ella le deja la herencia a su gata, Miau, y a sus criada.

programme.title: Vuelva el sábado
programme.desc: Una secretaria que va a ser despedida pide otra oportunidad como cobradora pero se enamora de su primer cliente.

programme.title: Un par de robachicos
programme.desc: Dos secuestradores roban a un niño para pedir rescate y la policía atrapa a dos despistados hombres inocentes.

programme.title: Un Cura de Locura
programme.desc: Un cura viaja a un pueblo lejano para buscar a un compañero desaparecido, y se mete en todas las locuras del lugar.

programme.desc: Una mujer adopta a un niño y descubre que puede amar nuevamente. Sin embargo, un hombre planea complicarle los planes.

programme.title: Tierra Baja
programme.desc: Un pastor se enamora de una mujer que a su vez está locamente obsesionada de un hombre sin escrúpulos.

programme.title: Ni solteros ni casados

programme.title: Me he de comer esa tuna
programme.desc: Un trío de simpáticos amigos se reencuentran después de muchos años. Han vuelto al pueblo para continuar con sus vidas y conocer a sus novias, pero sus fuertes bromas los llevarán por un divertido enredo que tendrán que resolver.

programme.title: Macabra la mano del diablo
programme.desc: Un arqueólogo mexicano desentierra una urna en la cual encuentra una mano humana que posee extraños poderes.

programme.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within
programme.desc: On day three of Mark Peterson's South America Upland Slam, the team is snowed in while waiting for better weather in La Pampa. Once cleared to fly, they arrive and head straight to the field.

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Randy Kitts heads to Canadian Whitetail Outfitters in Northern Saskatchewan for a chance a at a multi-droptine nontypical bush buck with his bow.

programme.title: Pursue The Wild
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Pursue the Wild, I take you deep into a Wyoming antelope season that tested more than just skill or patience-it tested everything. From blistering 100- degree days spent in the blind.
programme.sub-title: From Ashes to Arrow: Wyoming Archery Antelope Hunting After Heat, Wildfire & Flood

programme.title: For Love Or Likes
programme.desc: Things start to get heated as girls check trail cams and jealousy of daytime bucks start to set in. A competition with a twist causes chaos as girls compete to steal the best hunt zone and the first buck steps into shooting on the second evening.

programme.title: Yamaha Adventure Flim Series
programme.desc: From conquering the unforgiving granite of the Rubicon Trail to battling the mud and chaos of the Ironman GNCC, Yamaha's Proven Off-Road machines show what they're made of. The RMAX 1000 traverses one of the most rugged trails in North America.
programme.sub-title: Trail Tested, Race Proven: Wolverine RMAX 1000 & YFZ450R in Action

programme.title: Own The Season Tv
programme.desc: Art and Michelle travel east to hunt stingrays with Corey Brossman and Brossman bowfishing. Joining them is Jim Miller. After returning home Art meets up with his buddy Doug to do some early season goose hunting.
Team200 member Tarif Alkhatib hunts down his biggest Texas whitetail yet!

programme.title: Just Kill'n Time TV
programme.desc: Join Buck and Max as they take to the hills they call home to chase the kings of spring!
programme.sub-title: Spring Time is Just Kill'n Time Part II

programme.title: The Bearded Buck
programme.desc: This week Jerry and Austin accomplish the impossible. A single season turkey slam including all four sub-species. Except they put a twist on it, Father son duo-doubles only! What could go wrong?

programme.title: Weird Hunts
programme.desc: Hunting his own dirt, Matt is chasing after some antelope in a weird way. With not many water sources around, he puts out a water tank and plans to sit inside it and take one as they come in for a drink.

programme.title: Cabela's Deer Gear TV
programme.desc: Join us as we delve into the essentials of scouting for whitetail deer. Learn the best practices for identifying prime hunting locations, understanding deer behavior, and using technology to your advantage.

programme.title: Mojo Untamed
programme.desc: Nate and Jared hunt ducks with Dakota Stowers of Mesquite Hollow Outfitters.
Follow Adam Hays as he hunts for his 5th 200 inch whitetail in his home state of Ohio.

programme.title: Dream Makers
programme.desc: The Outdoor Adventure Foundation is all about making big outdoor dreams come true, and today, we are starting things off by making a TON of dreams come true at once!

programme.title: Man vs. Elk
programme.desc: We go after bull elk with a bow and rifle in Colorado at The Elk Ranch with Keith Dailey.

programme.title: Deertopia
programme.desc: From blood-trailing strategies to understanding deer behavior, Steve breaks down what every hunter needs to know to ensure a successful recovery.

programme.title: McWhorters Precision Hunting

programme.sub-title: South Texas Giants at Great Horizon

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures
programme.desc: Traveling to the Adirondack Mountains and caught up with George & Laurie Keith, who were chasing marten, otter, beaver and fisher. In two days, we probably checked over 100 traps in some of the most beautiful country in the US. Ride along with us.
programme.sub-title: George and Laurie catching Marten, Otter, Beaver and Fisher

programme.title: Hitmen

programme.title: Mass Pursuit Tv
programme.desc: Wilbur heads to Norton Valley Whitetails for some Bluegrass State action.

programme.title: Target Rich Environment
programme.desc: From night-time thermal hog hunting to high-flying helicopter action, the crew takes on Texas pigs in every way possible - then wraps it up with the opening day of dove season in Avalon, where the skies come alive at first light.

programme.title: Hank Parker's Outdoor Magazine

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: James and his good friend Brian Smith chase antelope in Montana.

programme.title: Surviving Mann

programme.sub-title: Dream Hunts at Ikamela Safaris: Red Lechwe, Black Wildebeest & a Mountain Waterbuck Pursuit!

programme.title: Shoot Straight TV

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age
programme.desc: Philip II of Macedon sets the stage for the rise of his son, Alexander the Great, by conquering Greece; when Alexander invades the Persian territory of Asia Minor in 334 B.C., he embarks on the greatest career of conquest the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age
programme.desc: After only two battles, Alexander commands more land than any Greek before him; he orders the Persian emperor to address him as an equal; at the height of his power, he visits Egypt, where he assumes the title of pharaoh and is hailed as a deity.

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age
programme.desc: Whether his Egyptian sojourn convinces Alexander that he is a god or just teaches him the political value of blurring the lines between human and divine; how Alexander brings the Persian emperor to battle as he resumes his drive eastward.

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age
programme.desc: Alexander has an effect on the political development of the eastern Mediterranean; opinions about him remain deeply divided, both in antiquity and the current day; whether one can discern the historical Alexander, or the myth has swallowed the man.

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age
programme.desc: A generation of warfare among Alexander's successors splits his empire; after these "wars of the Diadochi", three major Hellenistic kingdoms emerge under the control of Alexander's former officers.

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age
programme.desc: Ptolemy, one of Alexander's companions, transforms himself into a new pharaoh in Egypt even as he remains separate from the conquered Egyptians; how Ptolemy and his successors blend pharaonic and Macedonian practices to create a new kingdom.

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age
programme.desc: Alexandria is the seat of Ptolemy's court; the city's library and museum are the premier cultural institutions of the Hellenistic world; whether Alexandria is a blend of Greek and Egyptian elements or the imposition of one culture over the other.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: The lands around the central Turkish plateau historically "face" two ways; the western and southern shores are drawn to Greece and Europe; the mountain-ringed interior is linked to Iran and Asia proper.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: Neolithic Anatolians are among the first farmers and herders, dwelling in villages with sophisticated technology and organization; they learn to write and build palaces and cities from the Sumerians to the south.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: Beginning as invaders from the Balkans, the Indo-European people called the Hittites overrun Anatolia's core with their war chariots; they create a dynasty that rivals the Egypt of Ramses II.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: Hittite kings become the first of many conquerors who leave their mark on the land; near their ritual capital of Hattusas, they carve from rock an open-air shrine to their thousands of gods; shortly thereafter, Hattusas is sacked and abandoned.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: What archeologists actually do; the nature and scope of their work; misconceptions about the field; tracing the history of archeology, from its beginnings with the ancient Babylonian king Nabonidus to archeological luminaries of the 20th century.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Traveling to the sites of Pompeii and Herculaneum, which are destroyed by the 79 A.D. eruption of Mount Vesuvius; the history of their excavation; the preservation of buildings, objects and human remains; discovering details of ancient Roman life.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Following the exploits of Heinrich Schliemann as he looks for Homer's Troy; learning about his dig through nine stratified cities; the finds; the debates over which city is Troy; tracing subsequent work at the site; examining the conclusions.
programme.sub-title: Schliemann and His Successors at Troy

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: The history of finds in Mesopotamia; the 19th-century unearthing of the Assyrian palaces at Nimrud and Nineveh, with their libraries of cuneiform texts; contemplating the 20th-century discovery of the treasures of the "Death Pits of Ur".

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: The reasons to study the ancient Greeks; their iconic art and architecture, philosophy, religion and inventions of drama and democracy; the Greeks in cultural, historical and linguistic terms; the development and character of Greek civilization.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: Human habitation on the mainland and islands of Greece; the Bronze Age cultures of the Cycladic islands; the Minoan civilization centered on Crete; the Mycenaean civilization and its monumental architecture; Mycenae's connection with the Trojan War.
programme.sub-title: Bronze Age Greece: Minoans and Myceneans

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: Greece's Dark Age is an era of restricted trade and a breakdown of centralized power; the achievements of this epoch include iron technology, the Greek alphabet and the Olympic Games; Greece's geographical expansion; creation of city-states.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: Greece's Classical Age is an astonishing period of human accomplishment; defining events of the period; the 479 B.C.E. defeat of the Persians; the period of the Peloponnesian War; the emergence of Macedonia as a great power; Alexander's exploits.
programme.sub-title: Classical Greece: The Age of Pericles

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: The Christianization of the Roman world is one of the most important turning points in Western civilization; the issues to consider and the scholars whose seminal theories serve as the gateways to the course's different lines of exploration.
programme.sub-title: Religious Conflict in the Roman World

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: How are pagan gods worshiped in ancient Rome; using evidence both literary and archaeological, grasping the diverse assortment of religious practices in an empire that ranges from Britain to Egypt; comprising a fifth of the world's population.
programme.sub-title: Gods and Their Cities in the Roman Empire

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Rome's first emperor, Augustus, establishes an institution to venerate an emperor's spirit; which then resides as a god on Mount Olympus; how emperors take pains to deify their predecessors to position themselves next among that honored line.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Mystery cults are believed to be the worship to a particular god; the choice to join and undergo an initiation rite; specific cults and the question of whether they do form a bridge between paganism and Christianity, as some scholars maintain.

programme.title: Turning Points in American History

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Incarnate
programme.desc: After a single mother witnesses terrifying symptoms of demonic possession in her 11-year-old son (David Mazouz), a Vatican representative calls on wheelchair-bound scientist Dr. Seth Ember (Aaron Eckhart) to rid him of the evil spirit. Driven by a personal agenda rooted in his own tragic past, Ember enters the boy's unconscious mind where he confronts a demon as ferocious as it is ingenious.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: The Return
programme.desc: Joanna Mills (Sarah Michelle Gellar) has a successful career but feels her personal life is spinning out of control. She has few friends, an estranged father (Sam Shepard), and a crazy ex-boyfriend who is stalking her. Joanna begins having terrifying visions of a woman's murder, and it seems that she is the killer's next target. Determined to solve the mystery and escape her apparent fate, Joanna follows her visions to the victim's hometown and finds that some secrets just do not stay buried.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon (Odette Yustman) turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak (Gary Oldman) for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: Whisper
programme.desc: Ex-con Max Truemont (Josh Holloway) is desperate for money so he can start a new life with his fiancee (Sarah Wayne Callies). When he is unable to secure the funds by ordinary means, he takes part in a plan to kidnap the young son of one of the state's wealthiest women. While awaiting instructions at their remote hideout, the kidnappers begin to turn on each other, and Max realizes that the boy may have a supernatural hand in the horrific events that follow.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Twelve Monkeys
programme.desc: Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradiya (Joanna Pacula). When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.

programme.title: Webs
programme.desc: Electrical workers discover an underground portal leading to a parallel world where spider people rule Chicago.

programme.title: Slither
programme.desc: Wheelsy is a small town where not much happens and everyone minds his own business. No one notices when evil slips in quietly but, when people find mutilated livestock and a woman goes missing, Sheriff Bill Pardy (Nathan Fillion) discovers an alien organism that threatens to devour all life on Earth.

programme.title: Beneath
programme.desc: Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.desc: Released from a mental institution once again, Norman Bates (Anthony Perkins) calls in to tell his life story to a radio host (CCH Pounder). In the present, Norman lives with his pregnant wife, Connie (Donna Mitchell), fearing that his child will inherit his split personality disorder, and "Mother" will return to kill again.

programme.title: Rosewood Lane

programme.title: Saint Ange

She arrives to confront an unsettling lack of orphans, save for one (Lou Doillon) who acts far too childish for her age. Then the bizarre sights and sounds begin, which seem to elude detection by the only other servant (Dorina Lazar) or the gloomy institution's director (Catriona MacColl). Is this all in Anna's mind? Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors...

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: It is the first year of Germany's occupation of France. Allied officer Lt. Aldo Raine (Brad Pitt) assembles a team of Jewish soldiers to commit violent acts of retribution against the Nazis, including the taking of their scalps. He and his men join forces with Bridget von Hammersmark, a German actress and undercover agent, to bring down the leaders of the Third Reich. Their fates converge with theater owner Shosanna Dreyfus, who seeks to avenge the Nazis' execution of her family.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: While racing toward the town of Red Rock in post-Civil War Wyoming, bounty hunter John "The Hangman" Ruth (Kurt Russell) and his fugitive prisoner (Jennifer Jason Leigh) encounter another bounty hunter (Samuel L. Jackson) and a man who claims to be a sheriff. Hoping to find shelter from a blizzard, the group travels to a stagecoach stopover located on a mountain pass. Greeted there by four strangers, the eight travelers soon learn that they may not make it to their destination after all.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: When flight attendant Jackie Brown (Pam Grier) is busted smuggling money for her arms dealer boss, Ordell Robbie (Samuel L. Jackson), agent Ray Nicolette (Michael Keaton) and detective Mark Dargus (Michael Bowen) want her help to bring down Robbie. Facing jail time for her silence or death for her cooperation, Brown decides instead to double-cross both parties and make off with the smuggled money. Meanwhile, she enlists the help of bondsman Max Cherry (Robert Forster), a man who loves her.

programme.title: Death Proof
programme.desc: Stuntman Mike (Kurt Russell) is a professional body double who likes to take unsuspecting women for deadly drives in his free time. He has doctored his car for maximum impact; when Mike purposely causes wrecks, the bodies pile up while he walks away with barely a scratch. The insane Mike may be in over his head, though, when he targets a tough group of female friends, including real-life stuntwoman Zoe Bell (who served as Uma Thurman's double in "Kill Bill"), who plays herself.

programme.desc: While scavenging for copper wire, Detroit teenager Eli Solinski stumbles upon a high-tech gun that holds special powers. When his brother, Jimmy, lands in trouble with a local crime boss, the two siblings take the mysterious weapon and go on the run. Eli and Jimmy now find themselves in a life-and-death battle against an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their gun back.

programme.title: Ender's Game
programme.desc: When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all of the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protege to prepare him for the oncoming war.

programme.title: Voyagers
programme.desc: With the future of the human race at stake, a group of young men and women -- bred for intelligence and obedience -- embark on an expedition to colonize a distant planet. When they uncover disturbing secrets about the mission, they defy their training and begin to explore their most primitive natures. As life on the ship descends into chaos, they soon become consumed by fear, lust and an insatiable hunger for power.

programme.desc: Rick Stein visits the Mexican capital to sample the Aztec cuisine.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico

programme.title: El caballo bayo
programme.desc: Un jinete revolucionario y la mujer que lo ama y lo odia, buscan un tesoro de oro escondido en un lago.

programme.title: Más negro que la noche
programme.desc: Tres hermosas mujeres se trasladan a una vieja casona, heredada por la tía de una de ellas, y presencian cosas extrañas.

programme.title: Tacos al carbón
programme.desc: Un hombre con suerte gana un automóvil último modelo en una rifa, y su suerte le trae líos amorosos también.

programme.title: De sangre mexicana
programme.desc: En Chicago, un boxeador logra salir del alcohol con mucho sacrificio, pero ahora tiene que enfrentarse a un mafioso.

programme.title: De Sangre Mexicana 2
programme.desc: En Chicago, un boxeador supera al alcohol, las drogas y debe enfrentar a un mafioso poderoso que lo odia.

programme.title: Chicago, Pandillas Salvajes
programme.desc: Un padre mexicano vive en Chicago y tiene que enfrentar el hecho de que sus tres hijos son miembros de pandillas.

programme.title: Un rayo de luz
programme.desc: Un hombre de la nobleza adopta a una chica que cambiará alegremente la vida de todos en un castillo.

programme.title: Como perros y gatos
programme.desc: Dos compadres quieren casar entre sí a sus hijos, un ingeniero y una estudiante de psicología, pero ellos se detestan.

programme.title: Nido de tiburones
programme.desc: Tres buscadores de tesoros enfrentan asesinato y traición, además de aguas infestadas de tiburones en la costa africana.

programme.title: El agente viajero
programme.desc: Dos agentes viajeros viven una serie de situaciones cómicas cuando intentan vender ataúdes.

programme.title: Sucedió en México
programme.desc: Una mujer que planeaba suicidarse cambia de opinión y decide vivir e iniciar una nueva vida.

programme.title: La carrera del millón
programme.desc: Dos viejos hermanos millonarios apuestan en una carrera: el piloto que gane el rally se casará con su sobrina.

programme.title: El gran perro muerto
programme.desc: Arrollan a un perro común y el incidente provoca un enorme lío en un pueblo porque nadie quiere levantar sus restos y se produce un caos. El asunto llega a la capital del estado como cuestión federal, y el ejercito interviene para que vuelva la paz.

programme.title: Caballos de acero
programme.desc: Un joven rico es aficionado al motociclismo y conoce a un teniente de la policía con quien rivaliza en aptitudes.

programme.title: El Yaqui
programme.desc: Abandonan a un niño yaqui en un pueblo donde sus mayores fueron engañados para ser reclutados al ejército federal. Una prostituta se retira de su oficio para rescatar al menor y cuidarlo.

programme.title: El hijo de Gabino Barrera
programme.desc: El hijo de Gabino Barrera quiere vengar la muerte de su padre y tiene el apoyo de los campesinos, pero se enamora de la hija del presunto asesino, quien al confesar, desata un enfrentamiento.

programme.title: El puente
programme.desc: Un mexicano ilegal colabora con un cubano exiliado en los Estados Unidos a fin de ayudar a sus hermanos ilegales.

programme.title: Magnicidio: Complot en Lomas Taurinas
programme.desc: En los más altos niveles del gobierno se planean los asesinatos y se hace a un lado toda la lucha por mejorar los destinos de un país.

programme.title: El caballo del diablo
programme.desc: Un hombre malvado se viste de negro y monta su caballo del mismo color, para realizar cosas abominables e ilegales.

programme.title: Me quiero casar
programme.desc: Una joven americana, de turista en México, se enamora de un joven mexicano, y a ambos le esperan muchas aventuras.

programme.title: Contrabandistas del Caribe
programme.desc: Un humanitario gánster rescata a una mujer que se lanzó del yate de un contrabandista que quería abusar de ella.

programme.title: La mafia amarilla
programme.desc: Una pandilla china asesina a un hombre y Blue Demon, con la ayuda de su amigo, tiene que encontrar al culpable.

programme.title: The Last Rebel
programme.desc: Missouri, 1865, dos confederados (Joe Namath, Jack Elam) salvan la vida de un hombre (Woody Strode) y provocan problemas.

programme.title: La doncella de piedra
programme.desc: Una joven vuelve a Venezuela tras estudiar en Estados Unidos y ayuda a una tribu que la cree la doncella de una leyenda.

programme.title: El mexicano
programme.desc: Jacinto, un peleador que vence a todos sus rivales en Estados Unidos, ayuda a su hermano que es atacado por unos irlandeses. El antiguo rival de Jacinto mata a su esposa, por lo que Jacinto busca vengarse.
